characters.summary: Dr. Albert Wily is a rival robotics genius who reprograms industrial robots into powerful Robot Masters, fighting from his signature floating Wily Capsule escape vehicle when his fortresses fall.

techniques: Wily Capsule: homing energy balls with fire, electric and ice damage, electric drop (Smash Ultimate depiction)

mechanisms: Wily Capsule teleports away and reappears (Smash Ultimate depiction)

weaknesses: Cowardly demeanor and habit of begging for mercy upon defeat
Dependent on complex machinery
Grovels for forgiveness after each defeat
mobility: Wily Capsule escape pod; warps away when beaten
limitations: Zero personal physical combat prowess without mechanized assistance
Falls out of the Capsule when it is knocked out (Smash Ultimate)
